# EfficientNet-B3

Classification · `efficientnet-b3_300x300` · DX-APP C++ example

Classification model, evaluated on ILSVRC2012.

**Input** 300 × 300 × 3 · **Dataset** ILSVRC2012 · **License** BSD-3-Clause · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![EfficientNet-B3 output](../../../../python_example/image_classification/efficientnet/efficientnet-b3_300x300/result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/image_classification/efficientnet/efficientnet-b3_300x300/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models EfficientNetB3
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target efficientnet-b3_300x300_sync   # once
./bin/efficientnet-b3_300x300_sync \
  -m assets/models/efficientnet-b3_300x300.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/efficientnet/efficientnet-b3_300x300/efficientnet-b3_300x300_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/efficientnet-b3_300x300.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | Top1 |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 82.02 |
| Q-Lite | 81.56 (−0.46) |
| Q-Pro | 81.21 (−0.81) |

ILSVRC2012 · difference vs Raw in brackets.
